archived_zero_audit_positions: First 3 positions of each original image-seeded permutation; no outcome-based selection
IH_metric: p(first frozen gold tokenizer piece | retain one visual input) - p(first piece | remove all visual inputs)
zero_comparison_metric: exp(archived full first log p) - exp(archived singleton-zero first log p)
E: Unchanged native pre-projector CLIP residual; fresh features, errors and basis must match archived values exactly
scope: Add IH to the same 30 canonical input questions (12 GQA, 12 MMStar, 6 TextVQA). Calibrate on first two recorded questions per dataset at 32 positions; full 30 x 576 is gated. Completed six-case layer16 IH stays unchanged; input/layer scores are never pooled as one boundary.
reuse_gate: Exact CLIP/projector feature hashes, native E/basis, seed, prompt, positions, target IDs, full target-token scores and 3 archived zero-score repeats. Fresh baseline correctness and generated target prefix. Stop on any mismatch, including tiny drift; no retargeting or automatic reference replacement.
adaptations: Released-style physical deletion, supported 1x1 unit, native ApET SDPA runtime. Source-informed adaptation, not complete IH benchmark reproduction.

At input, slice prepared visual embeddings before the first decoder block, preserve all nonvisual embeddings and original RoPE position gaps. The native model constructs its own shortened causal mask; temporary RoPE hooks extend old lookup extent without changing values.
The null has no earlier decoder image processing; it still preserves the original image-placeholder positional gap and is not an ordinary text-only prompt.
IH scores first frozen reference tokenizer piece, not whole-answer correctness. Historical zeroing whole-answer score remains separate.
MMStar prior question/grounding flags remain labeled; no new cohort selection. No pooled-token significance or population claim.
